Among Public Undergraduate Mechanical Engineering Programs According to 2025-26 U.S. News & World Report Ranking
Undergraduate Mechanical Engineering Ranked 18th in the Nation in 2025
Our undergraduate curriculum combines strong foundations with advanced classes and research projects, while emphasizing attributes such as teamwork, ethics, and leadership. The program is designed to integrate out-of-classroom experiences, helping students explore career options and apply what they are learning in the real world.
READ MORE
Top 10
Among Public Graduate Mechanical Engineering Programs According to 2024-25 U.S. News & World Report Ranking
Graduate Mechanical Engineering ranked 17th in the Nation in 2025
Our research in mechanical and reliability engineering is driving advances across multiple foundational sciences and critical applications. Thanks to active research relationships with major research organizations, private companies, and government agencies, we generate transformational knowledge and achieve translational impact on real-world practice.
LEARN MORE
125+
years of engineering excellence serving the state of Maryland, the nation, and the world
Making a difference in one person's life or in the lives of many
A most striking thing about our department is the way so many people come together to achieve a common good. We unite around shared ideals of personal and societal growth and development in service of a better future. We give of our time, our resources, our energy, and our humanity to achieve long-lasting impact.
